programme.desc: Based on a popular comic featuring the adventures of a young triad gang in Mongkok, this sharp remake features a new generation in a razor-edged thriller.

programme.title: Echoes of the Rainbow
programme.desc: Set in the 1960s, the story revolves around a Hong Kong family & their shoe shop, as seen through the eyes of their eccentric 8-year-old son, after his elder brother becomes ill with leukemia.

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: A year ago, Bo became blind in a serious car accident. One day, an intruder enters her house and takes her hostage. As she tries to survive, she discovers her husband's involvement in her accident!

programme.title: WE 12
programme.desc: 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover agent Nick finds himself in a moral dilemma when the time to betray his mentor finally came. Starring Andy Lau, Louis Koo, Daniel Wu and more!

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng, a mainland streetfighter, tries to start a new life in Hong Kong's Walled City. When he becomes implicated in conspiracies among its triads, however, can he find a way to fight back?

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.

programme.title: S Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk must work with Inspector Lau to bring down a crime syndicate involved in illegal soccer betting. Though they did not start things well, they managed to complete the task together.

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao has amnesia & wakes up every day remembering nothing from the day before. He meets psychotherapist Xing Yue & they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: A high school student befriends a street punk as she copes with college entrance exam pressure and ruthless bullying. A murder investigation is set to alter both their lives.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny, a housewife skilled in mahjong, loses to Curvy on the mahjong table and in vying for her husband's love. With the help from her master, Fanny challenges Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A computer geek who has only been in love once suddenly & surprisingly finds himself getting romantically involved with five different women. Will he find "the-one"?

programme.title: Ah Boys to Men 2
programme.desc: Ken and his band of brothers return to serve the nation again, with Ken determined to change & prove himself a better man. However, his mates feel otherwise, causing tension among them.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fong and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by Wong Kar Wai, this epic action film begins in Foshan when Ip Man defending southern fighting styles against a master of the North, Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: A prisoner escaped under Master Zhang's custody, causing his expulsion. He sets off to find the prisoner, only to discover that the war between humans & demons have begun!

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Bullet and Brain now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Quan Dao: The Journey of a Boxer
programme.desc: Ah Niu learned boxing since young & uses his skills to help the weak. When his friend is brutally beaten up, Ah Niu accepts a death combat challenge to help him take revenge.

programme.title: Band Four

programme.desc: A man comes across a secret list of anti-Ching rebel names and quickly becomes a target for Ching loyalists.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friend's fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side.

programme.title: The Hidden Power of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: When defeated villain, Sung Ching-shu, restarts his reign of terror after mastering the yin and yang combination, only two swordsmen can stop him.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan| capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A martial artist joins the police force in order to pursue the man who killed his best friend but it is only years later that he discovers a startling clue.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: Martial arts greats Lau Kar Leung and Alexander Fu play out the vendetta of General Yang and the creation of the unique eight-diagram pole fight technique.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: Director Anthony Chan joins award-winning social satirist Alfred Cheung Kin Ting in this delightful variation on the hugely successful British Carry On!

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical production features George Lam in a humorous tale of a man who seeks love and success in a world of TV commercials, along with his two friends.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: When a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom, a persecuted waiter turns to a famed 'drunken master' for help.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: An extraordinary youth is determined to reunite with his goddess mother and unravel the mythical Lotus Lamp. Starring Linda Lin Dai.

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master (Lau Kar Leung) is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: A poor young woman becomes a popular bargirl in Hong Kong's gritty response to Hollywood's The World of Suzie Wong.

programme.title: The Sword Stained With Royal Blood
programme.desc: Havoc dogs a swordsman who uncovers a sword, training manual, treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased master.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Serio-comic clashes of cultures ensue when a Mainland Chinese family try to make a go of it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: 17-year-old Wong Fei Hung is prompted to go and do battle to avenge a friend's death and protect his family honour.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: At first, a gang just wants the village locksmith to open a stolen safe, but it soon escalates into wholesale torment when they are met with resistance.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: After a bride-to-be is discovered to be possessed, justice must be done and an exorcism performed before anyone can rest in peace.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: After the emperor's seal is stolen, 'The Rat' and 'The Cat's' squabble for martial arts supremacy is put on hold for a time.

programme.title: Black Magic 2

programme.title: Heads for Sale

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade

programme.title: The Flag of Iron

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep11
programme.desc: Aera kembali bersatu dengan rakan-rakannya. Mereka bertemu Jack, yang dimarahi kerana menukar lembunya dengan kacang ajaib. Namun, apabila pohon kacang gergasi tumbuh, pengembaraan besar pun bermula.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep12
programme.desc: Didi dan rakan-rakan cuba melarikan diri dari Gergasi dengan merancang helah bijak. Namun, ketika hampir berjaya, sesuatu berlaku yang membawa kepada pengakhiran tak dijangka.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep10
programme.desc: Didi, Nana dan Jojo bertemu dengan Bubu, seekor Itik yang dalam kesedihan kerana rasa dirinya berbeza dari Itik-Itik yang lain.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep11
programme.desc: Didi dan kawan-kawan bertemu dengan Jack yang berniat untuk mengambil harta Gergasi tanpa izinnya.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep12
programme.desc: Didi dan kawan-kawan mengajak semua membaca buku yang penuh dengan cerita menarik. Jom membaca, kerana buku adalah jambatan ilmu dan membawa banyak keseronokan!

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep1
programme.desc: Didi dan kawan-kawannya menemui sebuah perpustakaan ajaib. Tiba-tiba, Didi disedut masuk ke dalam buku bercahaya dan menjadi Kura-Kura. Jojo, Nana dan Aera perlu membaca buku itu untuk menyelamatkan Didi.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep2
programme.desc: Jojo, Nana dan Aera menemui buku ajaib baharu dimana Didi menjadi seekor Kancil. Dia dan Kura-Kura mengumpul buah, tetapi Monyet tiba-tiba muncul, berpura-pura lapar untuk meminta hasil mereka.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep3
programme.desc: Jojo disedut ke dalam buku dan jumpa Didi. Disana terdapat Belalang serta semut-semut yang sibuk bersiap untuk musim sejuk. Belalang asyik bermain muzik; Didi, Jojo dan semut-semut terus mengumpul makanan.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep1
programme.desc: Didi menjadi Kura-Kura dan berlumba dengan Arnab yang yakin dia paling laju.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep2
programme.desc: Didi dan kawan-kawan seronok mengumpul dan menyanyi tentang buah-buahan tempatan yang lazat!

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep3
programme.desc: Didi dan Jojo membantu semut-semut mengumpul makanan untuk musim sejuk, sementara Belalang asyik bermain muzik.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep4
programme.desc: Akar menjalar terus membesar menutupi perpustakaan magikal. Sementara itu, Didi dan Jojo bertemu dengan Beruang si penggembala yang suka meminta tolong kerana kebosanan. Tiba-tiba, Serigala muncul.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep5
programme.desc: Aera terus membaca ketika akar perlahan-lahan merayap ke dalam perpustakaan. Sementara itu, Didi, Nana dan Jojo membina rumah, tetapi sebaik sahaja siap, Serigala tiba-tiba muncul di hadapan mereka.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep6
programme.desc: Aera disedut ke dalam buku sebagai Si Tudung Merah. Dia berangkat melawat Nek Kura tetapi bertemu dengan Serigala. Serigala segera menculik Nek Kura, menyamar sebagai dirinya, dan menunggu ketibaan Aera.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep4
programme.desc: Didi dan Jojo bertemu Beruang yang suka menjerit tolong walaupun tiada apa-apa, tapi tiba-tiba Serigala muncul

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep5
programme.desc: Didi, Nana dan Jojo bina rumah di hutan, sebagai persediaan menghadapi ancaman dari Serigala.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep6
programme.desc: Aera jadi Si Tudung Merah dan ingat pesan ibu untuk sentiasa berhati-hati ke rumah Nek Kura.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep7
programme.desc: Nana menyelamatkan Aera tetapi terperangkap dalam buku. Di dalamnya, dia bertemu seekor Tikus yang ditangkap oleh Singa. Nana cuba meredakan keadaan dan meyakinkan Singa untuk melepaskan Tikus itu.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep8
programme.desc: Jojo tersedut ke dalam buku dan bertemu Nana serta Rubah. Mereka lihat Singa mengumpan haiwan ke gua tanpa ada yang keluar. Curiga, mereka merancang misi menyelamat, namun sesuatu tak dijangka berlaku.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time Ep9
programme.desc: Ketika akar terus merebak di perpustakaan ajaib, Didi masuk ke dalam buku dan menjadi Kancil. Dia nampak buah di seberang sungai dan tertanya-tanya cara menyeberang—hingga Buaya muncul, mencetuskan idea.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep7
programme.desc: Nana cuba menasihati dan yakinkan Singa untuk tidak marah dan lepaskan Tikus.

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep8
programme.desc: Nana, Jojo dan Musang rancang misi selamatkan haiwan yang tertipu — sangka Singa sakit, rupanya kena perangkap!

programme.title: Didi & Friends Story Time MV Ep9
